name: Multi-agent adversarial debate applied as a residual on the market price
one_line: Cross-vendor YES / NO advocates argue from one dated evidence pack, a price- and identity-blind judge outputs a probability that is applied only as a small logit-space correction to the Polymarket price, with an independent-ensemble control arm that switches the debate off; a veto-only red-team variant filters statistical signals.
maturity: Experimental; the one Polymarket test had debate 0.170 vs independent ensemble 0.159 vs market 0.152 (100 markets); the only forecasting deliberation gain (-0.020 log loss) has no market benchmark; no PnL anywhere
requires_ai: yes; LLM advocates, blind judge, red-team pre-mortems
edge: Hypothetical: adversarial evidence search adds information the price lacks, applied as a residual
capital: none until validation; then <$1k-$10k as file 21's book ($20-100 per position)
build_time: 3-4 weeks solo on top of file 21's harness
opportunity_size: A slice of file 21's long-tail pool; an independent LLM panel adds ~0 over the price so far
expected_results: no public data, theoretical only; guess within ±0.003 Brier of the ensemble residual
competition: paper-only GitHub bots and papers; no debate trader with PnL found
flag: none specific; US persons excluded, scraping restricted, injection risk
validate: Hindcast-style 450-market replay, eight arms; kill if debate residual = ensemble residual
top_risk: Debate adds nothing over an independent ensemble, which adds nothing over the price
solo_fit_reason: Cheap to test on top of file 21 (the control and single-agent arms reuse the debate's evidence pack), but every measurement points to no residual room: on 574 resolved Polymarket question-rounds an independent five-vendor residual changes Brier by -0.0011 [-0.0055, +0.0028] with pooled lambda 0.15; the one Polymarket debate test lost to both the ensemble and the price; debate costs 2-4x the control arm; in the 0.15-0.85 band the brief's 0.003 pass bar needs ~2,000-3,500 questions to detect.
speed_class: speed-insensitive: 5-15 minute runs; edge, if any, on day one after listing
results_10k: as file 21 plus the feature; -$700 to +$100/month (guess)
capacity_ceiling: file 21's ~$15-30k solo; the debate adds no capacity
changes_made: Written 2026-09-29 with live checks. Independent-ensemble control arm on ForecastBench's published zero-shot forecasts (files downloaded for file 55, not re-downloaded): 574 resolved Polymarket question-rounds mapped to Gamma categories through condition_ids (731 ids); residual sigma(logit q + lambda*(logit mean - logit q)) with lambda fitted walk-forward (pooled and per category, grid -1..1, training thresholds 25 / 40 / 80), question-clustered bootstrap; pooled -0.0011 [-0.0055, +0.0028], per-category noisier, single-vendor residual as good as the ensemble's.

T-7d replay pool: 1,010 markets (one per event, eight categories) from file 55's 2026 pool, CLOB prices-history before 7 days before the scheduled end, counted only if open at t (870): mid-band Brier by category and logistic recalibration slopes; politics slope 0.73 [0.33, 1.29], not the published 1.45.

Veto target at executed prices: Data API v1 /trades with start/end filters (takerOnly=true), 24 h after t, 329 favourite candidates, 270 with fills (9,147 fills, $1.96M): favourite buys +2.0c per market net [-2.7, +6.6]; politics +2.6c [-8.5, +13.0]; geopolitics +13.0c, Bonferroni interval over 8 categories includes zero.

Critic note applied: the reference-class proposer/challenger sub-variant is consolidated into file 70 (with file 68's reference-class tournament) and only pointed to here. Maturity set to Experimental (the brief's Emerging rested on attempts with no PnL).

Cite-check + skeptic pass 2026-09-29 (31 numbered sources re-fetched or re-queried: 25 arXiv entries via the arXiv API plus saved HTML for [1][2][13][15][20], ForecastBench datasets page, Polymarket fee docs, GitHub API (TradingAgents, six repos, six searches), HN Algolia, Data API v1 /trades start/end filter live, arXiv 2604.18576 confirmed to be 'Agentic Forecasting with Structured Linguistic Beliefs'; E7/E8/E9 passages checked; 27 confirmed, 4 corrected, 0 removed, 0 unreachable; fb_residual.py, calib_t7.py, veto_fills.py re-run and reproduce every headline number incl. file 55's 0.144 vs 0.079): (1) Veto fill test re-built on buyer-executable fills only (taker BUY of the favourite, taker SELL of the other token): the writer's 9,147 fills mixed in sells that hit the bid a mean 3.2c lower; on 5,120 fills / 247 markets favourites make +1.65c net [-3.34, +6.29] (was +2.02c), politics +0.23c [-10.95, +11.36] (was +2.60c), geopolitics +11.87c [+2.24, +19.61], Bonferroni [-3.12, +21.47] (v_fills_side.py). (2) Power re-derived from the question-level paired SD at fixed lambda in the 0.15-0.85 band the replay uses (v_power.py): residual-vs-mid SD 0.048-0.064 at lambda 0.15-0.20, so the 0.003 bar needs ~2,000-3,500 questions (was ~1,130 from the all-band walk-forward SD 0.036) and 0.005 ~720-1,270; residual-vs-residual SD 0.023-0.031; 450-question Phase 1 resolves ~0.006-0.008 vs the mid and ~0.003-0.004 between residuals; Phase 2's 350-resolution bar is in practice an observed ~0.005. (3) Replay look-ahead: replay_t7.py inherited file 55's 'lived >= 8 days' filter; 1,002 of 11,725 open-at-T-7d markets were dropped (Yes rate 0.269 vs 0.208); verifier re-pull of 159 of them (v_lookahead.py): mid-band 0.198; ex-ante mixture moves mid-band Brier 0.175 -> 0.176, politics 0.198 -> 0.200, tech 0.146 -> 0.152, culture 0.184 -> 0.191; category ranking unchanged. Midpoint sensitivity by lifetime-volume tercile none (0.174 / 0.180 / 0.171). Smaller fixes: ForecastBench rows come from 11 rounds due 2025-11-23 to 2026-04-26 (18 downloaded); 'questions' -> 'question-rounds'; Martingale Score wording (forecasting 'more prone', not 'strongest'); orallexa described from its README (Alpaca paper execution, prediction-market prices as one input) instead of a 'Paper-only' quote; TradingAgents 109,233 stars; file 55's corrected depth ($115-298 below $10k liquidity, $1.4-3.5k above, two snapshots); politics slope contrasted with Le's Polymarket mean 1.45 rather than called a contradiction. 15-field part 2,572 -> 2,539 words despite the additions.
open_doubts: The control arm is zero-shot without retrieval (ForecastBench); retrieval-fed debaters may add information the zero-shot panel lacks, so the measured null residual is a floor for the debate, not proof it fails.
ForecastBench's market_value_on_due_date is its own snapshot of the Polymarket price; the residual was not re-priced at recorded books.
Per-category lambda cannot be estimated at ~90 resolutions per category; the politics sign (lambda -0.90) may be noise.
Power figures assume the debate earns lambda 0.15-0.20 like the zero-shot ensemble; a debate that earns more weight has a larger paired SD and needs even more questions.

Buyer-executable fills in the 24 h after T-7d are a historical tape; a new trader's queue position and fill probability are not recoverable, and share-weighted figures are dominated by a few large markets.
The T-7d category Brier figures use CLOB prices-history raw midpoints; the lifetime-volume tercile split shows no sensitivity, but historical spreads were not recorded.
No debate was run; cost per forecast ($0.30-0.35) is an estimate from list prices and assumed token counts.
